```{r}
# sqrt
cp_rep1 <- read.csv("../Output/rep1/tcplfit_results/tcpl_results_global_test_chem_cat_pearson_none.csv")
cp_rep1$rep <- "rep1"
cp_rep1$is_sqrt <- TRUE

cp_rep2$rep <- "rep2"
cp_rep2$is_sqrt <- TRUE

cp_rep3 <- read.csv("../Output/rep3/tcplfit_results/tcpl_results_global_test_chem_cat_pearson_none.csv")
cp_rep3$rep <- "rep3"
cp_rep3$is_sqrt <- TRUE



# No sqrt

cp_rep1_nosqrt$rep <- "rep1"
cp_rep1_nosqrt$is_sqrt <- FALSE

cp_rep2_nosqrt$rep <- "rep2"
cp_rep2_nosqrt$is_sqrt <- FALSE

cp_rep3_nosqrt$is_sqrt <- FALSE

  dplyr::select(any_of(c("bmd", "name", "bmdl", "bmdu", "exp_name", "is_sqrt"))) %>%

  dplyr::mutate(name = forcats::fct_relevel(factor(name), top_names, after = Inf))


cp_plot <- ggplot(cp, aes(x = bmd, y = name, colour = is_sqrt, shape = exp)) +
```

##Load data
```{r}
# Load tcplfit results from a given rep's folder. Written as a self-contained
# function (rather than reassigning a shared `tcpl_results_folder` variable
# before each rep's `list.files()` call) so a stray edit or out-of-order
# chunk execution can't silently pull one rep's data from another rep's
# folder (or a non-folder path).
load_tcpl_folder <- function(folder) {
  list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) |>
    map_dfr(function(path) {
      label <- basename(path) |>
        str_remove("^tcpl_results") |>
        str_remove("\\.csv$")

      read.csv(path) |>
        mutate(
          low_variance    = str_detect(label, "lowvar"),
          pearson_thresh  = str_extract(label, "(?<=pearson_)[0-9.]+") |> as.numeric(),
          commonfeature = str_detect(label, "common"),
          removedfeatures = str_detect(label, "removed"),
          source_file    = basename(path),
          source_folder   = folder
        )
    })
}
rep1 <- load_tcpl_folder("../Output/rep1/tcplfit_results/")
rep2 <- load_tcpl_folder("../Output/rep2/tcplfit_results/")
rep3 <- load_tcpl_folder("../Output/rep3/tcplfit_results/")

joined <- rbind(rep1, rep2, rep3) %>%
  dplyr::filter(source_file != "tcpl_results_pearson_none.csv")%>% # same as _all_features, so removing one
  mutate(
    name = ifelse(name == "Taxol (Paclitaxel)", "Taxol", name),
    name = ifelse(name == "Berberine Chloride", "Berberine chloride", name)
  )%>%
  rename(exp = exp_name)
```

####checks
```{r}
# remove non responded chems

all_results <- all_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(!name %in% c("Metoclopramide", "Sorbitol", "5-Nitro-2-(3-phenylpropylamino)benzoic acid"))
# CI width per chemical x threshold
ci_width_by_chem <- all_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(bmd), !is.na(bmdl), !is.na(bmdu)) %>%
  mutate(log_ci_width = log10(bmdu) - log10(bmdl)) %>%
  group_by(name, pearson_thresh) %>%
  summarise(mean_log_ci_width = mean(log_ci_width, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


# Reproducibility (log BMD SD) per chemical x threshold — already per-chemical
reproducibility_by_chem <- all_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(bmd)) %>%
  group_by(name, pearson_thresh) %>%
  summarise(
    n_reps = n(),
    log_bmd_sd = sd(log10(bmd), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_reps >= 2)

# --- Combine into one long table for faceted plotting ---
by_chem_comparison <- ci_width_by_chem %>%
  full_join(reproducibility_by_chem %>% rename(mean_log_bmd_sd = log_bmd_sd),
            by = c("name", "pearson_thresh")) %>%
  arrange(name, pearson_thresh)

by_chem_comparison

# --- PLOT: one line per chemical, faceted by metric ---
na_placeholder <- min(by_chem_comparison$pearson_thresh, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.5

by_chem_comparison %>%
  mutate(
    is_na_thresh = is.na(pearson_thresh),
    pearson_thresh_plot = if_else(is_na_thresh, na_placeholder, pearson_thresh)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_log_ci_width, mean_log_bmd_sd),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pearson_thresh_plot, y = value, colour = name, group = name)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(na_placeholder, sort(unique(by_chem_comparison$pearson_thresh[!is.na(by_chem_comparison$pearson_thresh)]))),
    labels = c("NA", sort(unique(by_chem_comparison$pearson_thresh[!is.na(by_chem_comparison$pearson_thresh)])))
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Pearson correlation threshold", y = NULL, colour = "Chemical",
       title = "BMD modeling quality across correlation thresholds, by chemical")

# --- Average across chemicals, using the SAME per-chemical data as the individual lines ---
avg_across_chem <- by_chem_comparison %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_log_ci_width, mean_log_bmd_sd),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(pearson_thresh, metric) %>%
  summarise(avg_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# --- PLOT: individual chemical lines (thin, grey) + average overlay (bold, black) ---
na_placeholder <- max(by_chem_comparison$pearson_thresh, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.1

by_chem_long <- by_chem_comparison %>%
  mutate(
    is_na_thresh = is.na(pearson_thresh),
    pearson_thresh_plot = if_else(is_na_thresh, na_placeholder, pearson_thresh)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_log_ci_width, mean_log_bmd_sd),
               names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value))

avg_across_chem_plot <- avg_across_chem %>%
  mutate(
    is_na_thresh = is.na(pearson_thresh),
    pearson_thresh_plot = if_else(is_na_thresh, na_placeholder, pearson_thresh)
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = by_chem_long,
            aes(x = pearson_thresh_plot, y = value, group = name),
            colour = "grey75", alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = by_chem_long,
             aes(x = pearson_thresh_plot, y = value, group = name),
             colour = "grey75", size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = avg_across_chem_plot,
            aes(x = pearson_thresh_plot, y = avg_value, group = metric),
            colour = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = avg_across_chem_plot,
             aes(x = pearson_thresh_plot, y = avg_value, group = metric),
             colour = "red", size = 2.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(na_placeholder, sort(unique(by_chem_comparison$pearson_thresh[!is.na(by_chem_comparison$pearson_thresh)]))),
    labels = c("NA", sort(unique(by_chem_comparison$pearson_thresh[!is.na(by_chem_comparison$pearson_thresh)])))
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Pearson correlation threshold", y = NULL,
       title = "BMD modeling quality across correlation thresholds",
       subtitle = "Grey = individual chemicals, Red = average across chemicals")

```


##0.9 pie charts
```{r}
# List of replicate folders — update paths/names as needed
rep_dirs <- c(
  rep1 = "../Output/rep1",
  rep2 = "../Output/rep2",
  rep3 = "../Output/rep3"
)

rep_files <- file.path(rep_dirs, "test_chem_well_pearson_0.9.csv")
names(rep_files) <- names(rep_dirs)

# Read each file and extract the set of retained feature names (non-metadata)
retained_features <- imap(rep_files, function(path, rep_name) {
  df <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  feature_cols <- names(df)[!str_detect(names(df), "^Metadata_")]
  feature_cols
})

# Fit and plot the Euler diagram
fit <- euler(retained_features)
venn_colors <- scales::hue_pal()(3)

venn <- plot(fit,
     quantities = list(
       type = c("counts", "percent"),   # matches "n (pct%)" style from donut labels
       cex = 0.9,
       font = 2                          # bold, matches label_txt bold in donut
     ),
          fills = list(
       fill = venn_colors,
       alpha = 0.7
     ),
     edges = list(
       col = "white",                     # white borders between regions, matches geom_col(color="white")
       lwd = 2                            # thicker edge, matches segment.size bump you did earlier
     ),
     main = list(
       label = "Overlap of features retained after 0.9 Pearson filter",
       fontface = 2,                      # bold title, consistent weight with donut titles
       cex = 1
     ),
     legend = list(
       side = "right"                     # optional: moves category names to a side legend
                                            # instead of on-diagram labels, matching donut's legend.position="right"
     )
)

venn
ggsave("../Plots/cellprofiler/cellprofiler_venn_0.9.png", venn, width = 10, height = 10,units = "cm")

# --- Subset each rep down to the features common to all three ---

# Intersection of feature names across all three reps
common_features <- reduce(retained_features, intersect)
length(common_features)  # should be 183

# Re-read each rep's full retained file (rows + all its own retained columns),
# then subset to metadata + the common feature set
rep_common <- imap(rep_files, function(path, rep_name) {
  df <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  meta_cols <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), "^Metadata_")]
  df %>% dplyr::select(all_of(meta_cols), all_of(common_features))
})

# Write out the subsetted files, one per rep, into their own folders
iwalk(rep_common, function(df, rep_name) {
  write_csv(df, file.path(rep_dirs[[rep_name]], "test_chem_well_pearson_0.9_common.csv"))
})


feature_breakdown <- tibble(feature = common_features) %>%
  mutate(
     feature_base = str_remove(feature, "_(cells|cytoplasm|nuclei)$"),
    module = str_extract(feature, "^[^_]+"),
    region = str_extract(feature, "(cells|cytoplasm|nuclei)$"),
    channel1 = case_when(
      module == "Correlation" ~
        str_match(feature,
          "^Correlation_[^_]+_(AGP|ER|DNA|Mito|RNA)_(AGP|ER|DNA|Mito|RNA)_"
        )[, 2],
      TRUE ~ str_extract(feature, "_(AGP|ER|DNA|Mito|RNA)(_|$)") %>%
               str_remove_all("_")
    ),
    channel2 = case_when(
      module == "Correlation" ~
        str_match(feature,
          "^Correlation_[^_]+_(AGP|ER|DNA|Mito|RNA)_(AGP|ER|DNA|Mito|RNA)_"
        )[, 3],
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(c(module, region, channel1, channel2), as.character))

#deal why the multiple channels
feature_breakdown <- feature_breakdown %>%
  mutate(
    channel_pair = if_else(
      !is.na(channel2),
      paste(pmin(channel1, channel2), pmax(channel1, channel2), sep = "-"),  # order-independent, so DNA-Mito == Mito-DNA
      channel1
    )
  )
#function to make to pies
make_pie <- function(df, group_col, title) {
  counts <- df %>%
    dplyr::count(.data[[group_col]], name = "n") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[group_col]])) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(.data[[group_col]])) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pct = n / sum(n) * 100,
      ymax = cumsum(n),
      ymin = c(0, head(ymax, n = -1)),
      label_pos = (ymax + ymin) / 2,
      label_txt = paste0(n, " (", round(pct, 1), "%)")
    )

  # build one shared palette so fill and text color always match
  n_groups <- dplyr::n_distinct(counts[[group_col]])
  palette  <- scales::hue_pal()(n_groups)
  names(palette) <- unique(counts[[group_col]])

  ggplot(counts, aes(x = 2, y = n, fill = .data[[group_col]])) +
    geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    xlim(0.5, 3.6) +
    geom_label_repel(
      aes(y = label_pos, label = label_txt, color = .data[[group_col]]),  # <- match text color
      #x = 3.4,
      size = 3,
      fontface = "bold",              # helps colored text stay legible
      show.legend = FALSE,
      segment.color = "grey20",       # keep lines neutral so they don't blend into slices
      segment.size = 0.8,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      box.padding = 0.4,
      label.size = NA,
      fill = alpha("white", 0.85),    # label background stays white/light
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
    scale_color_manual(values = palette, guide = "none") +   # same palette, no separate legend
    labs(title = title, fill = group_col) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}
# Module plot
p_module <- make_pie(feature_breakdown, "module",
                      "Feature module distribution (0.9 Pearson filter)")
p_module
ggsave("../Plots/cellprofiler/cellprofiler_piechart_module_0.9.png", p_module, width = 12, height = 12,units = "cm")

# Region plot
p_region <- make_pie(feature_breakdown, "region",
                      "Feature region distribution (0.9 Pearson filter)")
p_region
ggsave("../Plots/cellprofiler/cellprofiler_piechart_region_0.9.png", p_region, width = 12, height = 12,units = "cm")

#Channel plot
p_channel_pair <- make_pie(feature_breakdown, "channel_pair",
                            "Feature channel distribution (0.9 Pearson filter)")
p_channel_pair
ggsave("../Plots/cellprofiler/cellprofiler_piechart_channel_0.9.png", p_channel_pair, width = 12, height = 12,units = "cm")

#checking the totals
check_total <- function(df, group_col) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::count(.data[[group_col]], name = "n") %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      total_n = sum(n),
      total_incl_na = sum(n),
      total_excl_na = sum(n[!is.na(.data[[group_col]])])
    )
}

check_total(feature_breakdown, "module")
check_total(feature_breakdown, "region")

#not every features has a dye
check_total(feature_breakdown, "channel1")

#not every features has a dye
check_total(feature_breakdown, "channel_pair")
module_counts_09 <- feature_breakdown %>%
  dplyr::count(module, name = "n_after") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct_after = n_after / sum(n_after) * 100)
```

```{r}
      ymin = c(0, head(ymax, n = -1)),
      label_pos = (ymax + ymin) / 2,
      label_txt = paste0(n, " (", round(pct, 1), "%)")
    )

  # build one shared palette so fill and text color always match
  n_groups <- dplyr::n_distinct(counts[[group_col]])
  palette  <- scales::hue_pal()(n_groups)
  names(palette) <- unique(counts[[group_col]])

  ggplot(counts, aes(x = 2, y = n, fill = .data[[group_col]])) +
    geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    xlim(0.5, 3.6) +
    geom_label_repel(
      aes(y = label_pos, label = label_txt, color = .data[[group_col]]),  # <- match text color
      #x = 3.4,
      size = 3,
      fontface = "bold",              # helps colored text stay legible
      show.legend = FALSE,
      segment.color = "grey20",       # keep lines neutral so they don't blend into slices
      segment.size = 0.8,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      box.padding = 0.4,
      label.size = NA,
      fill = alpha("white", 0.85),    # label background stays white/light
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
    scale_color_manual(values = palette, guide = "none") +   # same palette, no separate legend
    labs(title = title, fill = group_col) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}
```

```{r}
module_retention <- module_counts_none %>%
```

##Load data
```{r}
# Load tcplfit results from a given rep's folder. Written as a self-contained
# function (rather than reassigning a shared `tcpl_results_folder` variable
# before each rep's `list.files()` call) so a stray edit or out-of-order
# chunk execution can't silently pull one rep's data from another rep's
# folder (or a non-folder path).
load_tcpl_folder <- function(folder) {
  list.files(folder, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) |>
    map_dfr(function(path) {
      label <- basename(path) |>
        str_remove("^tcpl_results") |>
        str_remove("\\.csv$")

      read.csv(path) |>
        mutate(
          pearson_thresh  = str_extract(label, "[0-9.]+") |> as.numeric(),
          source_file    = basename(path),
          source_folder   = folder
        )
    })
}
rep1 <- load_tcpl_folder("../Input/pearson_tcplfit2/rep1")
rep1$exp <- "rep1"
rep2 <- load_tcpl_folder("../Input/pearson_tcplfit2/rep2")
rep2$exp <- "rep2"
rep3 <- load_tcpl_folder("../Input/pearson_tcplfit2/rep3")
rep3$exp <- "rep3"
joined <- rbind(rep1, rep2, rep3) %>%
  mutate(
    name = ifelse(name == "Taxol (Paclitaxel)", "Taxol", name),
    name = ifelse(name == "Berberine Chloride", "Berberine chloride", name)
  )


#filtering
  joined <- joined %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      minDose = min(conc, na.rm = TRUE),
      maxDose = max(conc, na.rm = TRUE),
      removal_reason = dplyr::case_when(
        hitcall < 0.9   ~ "low_hitcall",
        is.na(bmdl)     ~ "missing_bmdl",
        is.na(bmdu)     ~ "missing_bmdu",
        TRUE            ~ "kept"
      ),
      keep = removal_reason == "kept",
      bmd  = ifelse(keep, bmd,  NA),
      bmdl = ifelse(keep, bmdl, NA),
      bmdu = ifelse(keep, bmdu, NA),
      exp = exp
    )
```

```{r}
# List of replicate folders — update paths/names as needed
rep_dirs <- c(
  rep1 = "../Input/pearson_cutoffs_well_level/rep1",
  rep2 = "../Input/pearson_cutoffs_well_level/rep2",
  rep3 = "../Input/pearson_cutoffs_well_level/rep3"

rep_files <- file.path(rep_dirs, "test_chem_pearson_0.9.csv")
names(rep_files) <- names(rep_dirs)
# Read files and add Metadata_ prefix to first 3 columns
rep_data  <- lapply(rep_files, function(file) {
  df <- read.csv(file)
  
  names(df)[1:3] <- paste0("Metadata_", names(df)[1:3])
  
  df
})

names(rep_data) <- names(rep_files)

# Read each file and extract the set of retained feature names (non-metadata)
retained_features <- imap(rep_data, function(df, rep_name) {
  names(df)[!str_detect(names(df), "^Metadata_")]
})
# Fit and plot the Euler diagram
fit <- euler(retained_features)
venn_colors <- viridisLite::viridis(3)

venn <- plot(fit,
     quantities = list(
       type = c("counts", "percent"),   # matches "n (pct%)" style from donut labels
       cex = 0.9,
       font = 2                          # bold, matches label_txt bold in donut
     ),
          fills = list(
       fill = venn_colors,
       alpha = 0.7
     ),
     edges = list(
       col = "white",                     # white borders between regions, matches geom_col(color="white")
       lwd = 2                            # thicker edge, matches segment.size bump you did earlier
     ),
     main = list(
       label = "Overlap of features retained after 0.9 Pearson filter",
       fontface = 2,                      # bold title, consistent weight with donut titles
       cex = 1
     ),
     legend = list(
       side = "right"                     # optional: moves category names to a side legend
                                            # instead of on-diagram labels, matching donut's legend.position="right"
     )
)

venn
ggsave("../Plots/columbus/columbus_venn_0.9.png", venn, width = 10, height = 10,units = "cm")

# --- Subset each rep down to the features common to all three ---

# Intersection of feature names across all three reps
common_features <- reduce(retained_features, intersect)
length(common_features)  # should be 183

# Re-read each rep's full retained file (rows + all its own retained columns),
# then subset to metadata + the common feature set
rep_common <- imap(rep_data, function(df, rep_name) {
  meta_cols <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), "^Metadata_")]
  
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      all_of(meta_cols),
      all_of(common_features)
    )
})

# Write out the subsetted files, one per rep, into their own folders
iwalk(rep_common, function(df, rep_name) {
  write_csv(df, file.path(rep_dirs[[rep_name]], "test_chem_well_pearson_0.9_common.csv"))
})

  "Axial", "Compactness", "Radial", "Symmetry", "Gabor",

  "position", "Position", "Texture", "Morph"
)

feature_breakdown <- tibble(feature = common_features) %>%
  mutate(
    module = str_extract(
      feature,
      paste(module, collapse = "|")
    ),
        region = str_extract(
      feature,
      regex("Cell|Cytoplasm|Nucleus|Ring|Membrane", ignore_case = TRUE)
    ),
    channel = str_extract(feature, "(AGP|ER|DNA|Mito|RNA)")
  ) %>%
    mutate(
    module = ifelse(module == "position", "Position", module),
    module = ifelse(module == "intensity", "Intensity", module)
  )%>%
  mutate(across(c(module, region, channel), as.character)) 

feature_breakdown['module'][feature_breakdown['module']=="Gabor"|feature_breakdown['module']=="Haralick"|feature_breakdown['module']=="SER"] <- "Texture"

#function to make to pies
make_pie <- function(df, group_col, title) {
  counts <- df %>%
    dplyr::count(.data[[group_col]], name = "n") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[group_col]])) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(.data[[group_col]])) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pct = n / sum(n) * 100,
      ymax = cumsum(n),
      ymin = c(0, head(ymax, n = -1)),
      label_pos = (ymax + ymin) / 2,
      label_txt = paste0(n, " (", round(pct, 1), "%)")
    )

  # build one shared palette so fill and text color always match
n_groups <- dplyr::n_distinct(counts[[group_col]])

palette <- viridisLite::viridis(n_groups)
names(palette) <- unique(counts[[group_col]])

  ggplot(counts, aes(x = 2, y = n, fill = .data[[group_col]])) +
    geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
    coord_polar(theta = "y") +
    xlim(0.5, 3.6) +
    geom_label_repel(
      aes(y = label_pos, label = label_txt, color = .data[[group_col]]),  # <- match text color
      #x = 3.4,
      size = 3,
      fontface = "bold",              # helps colored text stay legible
      show.legend = FALSE,
      segment.color = "grey20",       # keep lines neutral so they don't blend into slices
      segment.size = 0.8,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      box.padding = 0.4,
      label.size = NA,
      fill = alpha("white", 0.85),    # label background stays white/light
      max.overlaps = Inf
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
    scale_color_manual(values = palette, guide = "none") +   # same palette, no separate legend
    labs(title = title, fill = group_col) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}

#forcing specific coloring on this pie to make it match 
all_modules <- c("Area", "Axial", "Compactness", "Intensity", "Length",
                 "Position", "Profile", "Radial", "Ratio", "Roundness",
                 "Symmetry", "Texture", "Width")
module_colors <- setNames(viridis(length(all_modules), direction = -1), all_modules)
p_module <- make_pie(feature_breakdown, "module",
                      "Feature module distribution (0.9 Pearson filter)")
```

```{r}
# List of replicate folders — update paths/names as needed

# Fit and plot the Euler diagram
fit <- euler(retained_features)
venn_colors <- viridisLite::viridis(3)

venn <- plot(fit,
     quantities = list(
       type = c("counts", "percent"),   # matches "n (pct%)" style from donut labels

       font = 2                          # bold, matches label_txt bold in donut
     ),
          fills = list(
       fill = venn_colors,
       alpha = 0.7

     edges = list(
       col = "white",                     # white borders between regions, matches geom_col(color="white")
       lwd = 2                            # thicker edge, matches segment.size bump you did earlier
     ),
     main = list(
       label = "Overlap of features retained after no Pearson filter",
       fontface = 2,                      # bold title, consistent weight with donut titles
       cex = 1
     ),
     legend = list(
       side = "right"                     # optional: moves category names to a side legend
                                            # instead of on-diagram labels, matching donut's legend.position="right"
     )
```

###Retention
```{r}
module_retention <- module_counts_none %>%
  dplyr::full_join(module_counts_09, by = "module") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_before   = tidyr::replace_na(n_before, 0),
    n_after    = tidyr::replace_na(n_after, 0),
    pct_before = tidyr::replace_na(pct_before, 0),
    pct_after  = tidyr::replace_na(pct_after, 0),
    retention_rate = ifelse(n_before > 0, n_after / n_before * 100, NA_real_),
    share_change   = pct_after - pct_before   # change in composition share, not retention
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(n_before))

module_retention

reten <- module_retention %>%
  filter(!is.na(retention_rate)) %>%
  mutate(
    module = reorder(module, retention_rate),
    label = paste0(sprintf("%.1f", retention_rate), "%  (", n_after, "/", n_before, ")"),
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = module)) +
  # background bar = n_before (context / starting size)
  geom_col(aes(x = n_before), fill = "#21918c") +
  # foreground bar = n_after (overlapping, narrower/darker)
  geom_col(aes(x = n_after),  fill= "#440154", col = "#440154",width = 0.7, alpha= 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(x = n_before, label = label), hjust = -0.05, size = 3) +
  scale_x_log10(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.35))) +
  theme_bw() +
   theme(
    legend.position = "right",
     axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black", margin = margin(r = 5)),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size =10, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Number of features (grey = before, colour = after)", y = NULL)
ggsave("../Plots/columbus/retension.png", reten, width = 15, height = 10,units = "cm")
```
